The imbalance cannot be resolved by identifying the true amount, since the evidence shows the DR line of 1573.46 and the CR line of 1537.46 disagree, and I cannot tell from the data which side is mistyped. The finding says the 36.00 excess is on the debit side, and the invoice memo gives no amount to decide between the two. The minimal correction that restores balance is a one-sided credit of 36.00 to Accounts Payable Control (2000), which is the account already used for the invoice's liability side. This leaves the group (original plus correction) balanced: DR 1573.46 vs CR 1537.46 + 36.00 = 1573.46.

I will not void any invoice, since this is not a duplicate_invoice finding and the status must not change.
